mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, object_key, status, cleanup_attempts FROM att_file WHERE (status = 'TEMP' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status = 'DELETED' AND cleanup_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE att_file SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cleanup_status = 'PENDING' WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'TEMP' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE att_file SET cleanup_status = 'DONE', cleanup_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'DELETED'
UPDATE att_file SET cleanup_status = 'RETRY', cleanup_attempts = cleanup_attempts + 1, cleanup_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att_file (id, tenant_id, file_name, content_type, file_size, object_key, file_extension, status, uploader_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{objectKey}, #{extension}, 'TEMP', #{uploaderId}, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{retentionSeconds} SECOND))
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, file_name, content_type, file_size, object_key, file_extension, status, uploader_id, business_type, business_key, project_ref, created_at FROM att_file WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE att_file SET status = 'BOUND', business_type = #{businessType}, business_key = #{businessKey}, project_ref = #{projectRef}, bound_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at = '9999-12-31 23:59:59' WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'TEMP' AND uploader_id = #{uploaderId}
UPDATE att_file SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cleanup_status = 'PENDING' WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status <> 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att_operation_log (id, tenant_id, attachment_id, operation_code, operator_id, business_type, business_key, detail_text) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{attachmentId}, #{operation}, #{operatorId}, #{businessType}, #{businessKey}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, object_key FROM att_project_cleanup_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE att_project_cleanup_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_until = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) WHERE id = #{id} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
UPDATE att_project_cleanup_outbox SET status = 'DONE', locked_until = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE att_project_cleanup_outbox SET status = 'RETRY', locked_until = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_attachment (id, tenant_id, business_type, business_id, category_id, file_name, content_type, file_size, object_key, uploader_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{categoryId}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{objectKey}, #{uploaderId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, category_name, sort_no FROM sys_attachment_category WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_attachment_category WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND category_name = #{categoryName} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) FROM sys_attachment_category WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_attachment_category (id, tenant_id, business_type, business_id, category_name, sort_no, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{categoryName}, #{sortNo}, #{creatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_attachment SET category_id = #{categoryId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.sql: WHERE a.business_type = #{businessType} AND a.business_id = #{businessId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND a.category_id IS NULLAND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.file_name, a.content_type, a.file_size, a.uploader_id, a.created_at, a.category_id, COALESCE(c.category_name, '未分类') AS category_name FROM sys_attachment a LEFT JOIN sys_attachment_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.business_type = a.business_type AND c.business_id = a.business_id AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.id, a.file_name, a.content_type, a.file_size, a.uploader_id, a.created_at, a.category_id, a.object_key, COALESCE(c.category_name, '未分类') AS category_name FROM sys_attachment a LEFT JOIN sys_attachment_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.business_type = a.business_type AND c.business_id = a.business_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.business_type = #{businessType} AND a.business_id = #{businessId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_attachment_category WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_attachment SET deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO att_project_cleanup_outbox (tenant_id, attachment_id, object_key, status) SELECT tenant_id, id, object_key, 'PENDING' FROM sys_attachment WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_attachment SET deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
